Input

A single-line text field for collecting short user input — email, name, search. All states map to tokens, so focus, error and disabled stay on-brand. The fields below are live.

5 stateslabel · hint · errorToken-driven

Preview

We'll never share your email.

States

Default → hover → focus (secondary ring) → error (danger) → disabled.
Default
Focussecondary ring
Filled
Enter a valid email.
Errordanger border
Disabled

Compositions

Label, required marker, and error message — combine as needed.
Must be at least 8 characters.

Anatomy

The parts of a field and the token each is bound to.
Helper text.
height → --size-input (44px) border → --color-border radius → --rounded-md focus → --color-secondary + ring error → --color-danger label → --font-size-label placeholder → --color-text-placeholder

Border--color-border#E2E8F0

Border · focus--color-secondary#2693EC

Code

          
<Input label="Email address" name="email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" hint="We'll never share your email." />
<Input label="Email address" name="email" error errorMessage="Enter a valid email address." value="not-an-email" />

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Always pair the input with a visible label.
  • Use the hint for format help, the error for what went wrong.
  • Show the error state only after the user leaves the field.
✗ Don't
  • Don't use placeholder as the only label — it vanishes on type.
  • Don't hard-code the focus colour; use the token.
  • Don't make fields shorter than the 44px tap target.
